text:
isabel (Marketing): Drafting a one-pager well call 'Secure Nexus' one-sheet: 1-line exec summary, quick benchmark bullet, webinar hook (45m), and inbound routing rules for enterprise leads. Can people review?

teo (Product): Love the name. Please include a short line on model-version pinning and automatic fallback to smaller variants when capacity is constrained. Also call out KMS + audit log options for Private.

omar (Field): Bench data proposal: test config = burst 180 concurrent clients, seq len 512, model=redwood-stable-quant. Numbers to show: Hosted (standard): p50=130ms p99=365ms cost=$0.18 / 1k tokens. Dedicated (reserved GPU): p50=38ms p99=55ms throughput=160 req/s/GPU cost=$0.045 / 1k tokens. Add quick note: quantization reduces memory but may require evals for critical prompts.

claire (Sales): Inbound routing recommendation: tag leads with {segment:enterprise, product-interest:private, compliance:needs-audit}. Route to AE-Enterprise; if compliance present, also add queue.compliance-escalation and alert solutions-engineer. Capture expected peak qps on form.

omar (Field): Minimal infra routing snippet we can hand to infra ops:
```yaml
routing_rules:
  - if: tags.segment == 'enterprise' and tags.product-interest == 'private'
    route: queue.AE-Enterprise
    priority: 80
  - if: tags.compliance == 'needs-audit'
    route: queue.compliance-escalation
    priority: 95
  - fallback: queue.SDR-inbound
```

teo (Product): SLA blurb suggestion: "SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime on Dedicated plans. Latency SLOs published per deployment; we offer custom SLOs for on-prem and enterprise contracts. Automatic model-variant fallback reduces failure modes during capacity constraints."

isabel (Marketing): Webinar outline (45m): 7m market + 12m demo (deploy modes + console tour) + 12m benchmark deep dive + 8m customer panel (real pilot) + Q&A/CTAs. CTA = request private trial + schedule onboarding call. Claire will own panel and CTAs.

claire (Sales): I'll draft registration copy: "Secure Nexus: How teams meet enterprise SLAs and lower runtime costs without sacrificing model fidelity. Live demo + pilot stories + Q&A. Reserve a private trial slot." Also adding FAQ for field.

infra-bot: Assets uploaded: /assets/secure-nexus/onepager-v1.pdf and /assets/secure-nexus/webinar-landing.html. Docs stub: https://playbook.internal/secure-nexus.

omar (Field): Two-line customer blurb for slide 1: "CloudBank ran a two-week Private pilot on Redwood Dedicated and cut inference costs by 2.7x while sustaining 99.95% uptime. Pilot used dedicated GPUs in their VPC and kept full audit trails."

isabel (Marketing): Two quick asks before I finalize v1: (1) @omar please confirm CloudBank blurb copy ok to publish, (2) @teo confirm Dedicated p99 numbers. I'll iterate and publish the one-pager + short launch post + webinar invite once confirmed. Thanks! :sparkles:
